messages:
IncidentBot: [PAGER] inference-host-eu HIGH error rate detected (>5% 5xx) at 2026-03-14T02:10Z. p50 latency spike. Primary: Alex W. Join bridge: https://redwood.incidents/INC-2048 and runbook: https://play.redwood.ai/runbooks/inference-high-errors
Alex W: On it. I'm currently primary but I need to hand off before 18:00 PST today — I have a family commitment. Can someone take the overnight from ~18:00 PST -> 08:00 PST? :wave:
Mira Chen: I can take primary from 18:00->02:00 PST (first chunk). After that I need a handoff to APAC.
Sam Li: I can cover APAC spike window 02:00->08:00 PST. Happy to be secondary until you take over, Mira.
Alex W: Thanks both. Quick notes: customers in EU saw intermittent 503s, impact limited to model-reroute path. Root cause looks like a burst of KV cache misses plus a slow node. Logs show OOM-ish garbage collect on host-a-12.
Jordan Patel: If we're scaling, prefer to add warm instances instead of single big node. runbook step 2 says to try hot-spawn: `redwood admin pool-scale --name eu-infer --add 2 --warm` — this preserves routing. Also check `kubectl logs inference-host-a-12 -n redwood --tail 200` for GC traces.
Mira Chen: Running `kubectl exec -it inference-host-a-12 -- journalctl -u driver` now. If it's GC/oom, we should drain and remove host-a-12 from pool: `redwood admin host-drain host-a-12` then `redwood admin pool-scale --name eu-infer --add 1` to replace.
IncidentBot: NOTE: automatic fallback to model-variant `gpt-small-fallback` enabled for affected routes. Telemetry: 42 customers saw >=1 failed call in last 10m.
Sam Li: I'll prep the APAC handover note: key checks for incoming oncall: 1) latency dashboard (per-route) 2) error logs 3) pool healthy hosts. Link: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/latency?region=eu
Alex W: Mira — assign primary in PagerDuty so escalation goes to you. Sam — please be set as secondary in PD. I don't want any missed escalations overnight.
Mira Chen: Assigned in PD. Taking the bridge in 10m to sync with Alex and Sam.
Sam Li: Also noticed a batch job that started at 02:05Z targeting `embedder-eu`. If it's saturating GPU queue, we should throttle it. Command to throttle: `redwood jobs throttle --name nightly-embeds --limit 1`
Jordan Patel: Good catch. I've temporarily throttled the job to 1 and started adding 2 warm instances to eu-infer. Watching redis and model cache hit-rate.
Mira Chen: Confirmed host-a-12 shows repeated GC cycles and OOM logs. Draining now.
IncidentBot: Host drain triggered by Mira Chen for host-a-12. Pool eu-infer scaled +2 warm instances. Telemetry will rebalance in ~30s.
Alex W: Customer impact: 42 customers with transient 5xx, most recovered after fallbacks. Post-incident action: add better KV-cache warmup for rolling deploys and add alert for sustained GC > 3 cycles/min.
Sam Li: I'm on-call for APAC window and will watch until 08:00 PST. If Mira needs to extend beyond 02:00 PST, ping me and I'll take immediate handoff.
Mira Chen: Thanks. I'll leave detailed handoff in PD and mark runbook step complete. Leaving bridge to Sam at 01:58 PST. :thumbsup:
Jordan Patel: Adding postmortem stub: https://play.redwood.ai/postmortems/INC-2048-draft — I'll fill infra notes.
Alex W: Appreciate the quick response. Please post follow-up notes and any required config changes. I'll own the postmortem with Jordan.
Mira Chen: Handover complete to Sam. Ending my watch.
Sam Li: Taking over primary. Monitoring dashboards — latency normalizing, errors trending down. Will update if anything changes.
IncidentBot: INCIDENT status -> mitigated. Will auto-close if no regressions in 60m.
Sam Li: Leaving a quick checklist for whoever follows: - confirm PD assignment - confirm fallback routes - ensure nightly jobs are limited - check host GC thresholds - add KV warmup to deploy pipeline
Alex W: Thanks everyone. Follow-up action items: 1) Add KV warmup task to deploy pipeline (Engineering) 2) Alert for sustained GC (Eng-infra) 3) Review job scheduling for embedder (ML infra).
Mira Chen: Logged tasks in Jira: RD-4821, RD-4822, RD-4823.
Sam Li: I'll stay on until 08:00 PST and then hand back to rotation. :coffee:
IncidentBot: Closing note: page root cause likely combination of cache miss storm + single-node GC/OOM. Postmortem link above.
